messages:
anna: quick design review — pushing a small iteration for API Credentials (create/rotate/revoke). opened a figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX — focus is on the ephemeral reveal + rotate fallback + empty states. looking for copy + a11y + tab-order nits. jess: nice! main thing i noticed: the reveal modal auto-hides after 5s — feels too short for keyboard users. can we make it dismissible and keep the copy button focused? also after rotate, focus should land on the new key row. sam: accessibility note: don't let the screen reader read the literal secret. recommend announcing a non-sensitive status instead. e.g. aria-live="polite" with message: 'New API key generated and copied to clipboard'. avoid `aria-live` assertive for secrets. mike: copy suggestion for the rotate modal: "This is the only time you'll be shown the secret. Save it now — you won't be able to view it again." alternative: "Save this key now — it cannot be retrieved later." which reads better? anna: i prefer the second short line. also thinking about revoke: current pattern immediately hard-revokes. proposal: soft-delete state for 24h with an undo toast. makes accidental revokes recoverable and reduces support tickets. thoughts? jess: soft-delete + toast sounds good. UI nit: the revoke modal is pretty large; can we collapse warnings into progressive disclosure? show the minimal CTA and a subtle "Why this matters" accordion for teams that need details. sam: plus: keyboard focus order inside modal should be: cancel -> reason textbox (optional) -> revoke (primary). ensure pressing escape closes modal and returns focus to the previously focused row. mike: for teams with RBAC, we should put a small inline permission check in the modal: "You need admin role to rotate this key" with a link to docs. copy: "Contact your admin or request access." anna: small copy proposal for the create flow empty state: "Create an API key to start sending requests. Keep the secret safe — you can only see it once." button: "Create API key" (primary). secondary: "Learn about scopes". jess: implementation checklist for frontend: 1) keep reveal visible until user dismisses or clicks copy; 2) focus 'Copy' by default; 3) add keyboard-only affordance for showing secret (space/enter on toggle); 4) add storybook scenarios for screen reader + keyboard. sam: sample aria snippet for announce (happy to iterate): ```
New API key generated and copied to clipboard.
``` and the copy button should set a separate aria-live message on success rather than exposing the secret. anna: good — i also want to add a subtle security banner on the credential list when there are old keys >180 days: "Rotate keys older than 180 days" with a one-click filter. mike: for rotate fallback: if the rotate job fails (rare), we should surface a clear rollback copy: "Rotation failed — previous key still active. Try again or contact support." maybe include a retry button in the banner. jess: small UX microcopy for revoke undo toast: "Key revoked. Undo" (undo available for 24h). if undone, animate returning the row to the list and announce "Key restore successful" via aria-live. sam: test matrix i want: NVDA on Windows, VoiceOver on mac, TalkBack quick checks, keyboard-only tab flow, and a high-contrast check for the revoke/warning banners. i'll pair with QA for a run. ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "design/credentials -> proposal updated" (link: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX). anna: ok assigning follow-ups: jess — implement storybook + PR for modal focus + reveal duration; sam — provide checklist + sample axe rules; mike — finalize copy in the docs page. i'll sync in tomorrow's design sync. :thumbsup:
